cues: Solid oak sides support evenly spaced horizontal boards, leaving room for tall atlases and narrow poetry volumes.
Adjustable levels let a study display hardbound dictionaries beside slim paperbacks without wasting vertical space.
Polished timber panels stand beside a reading chair, their tiers arranging volumes by height.
Carefully joined wooden corners keep a tall storage piece steady beneath the weight of several reference volumes.
Varnished boards spaced at regular intervals make a narrow study fixture useful for organizing manuals and novels.
Floor-level supports prevent a loaded wooden unit from rocking when large dictionaries occupy its bottom tier.
Light passes between its levels, revealing colorful spines arranged within a sturdy room furnishing.
Removable horizontal planks accommodate changing collections, from compact paperbacks to oversized illustrated volumes.
